test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

My father teaches students.

options.text: Students are being taught by my father
Students are taught by my father.
A student is taught by my father.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Students are taught by my father.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is an example of an **active voice of simple present tense.**
 
• **Structure**:
 
 
• Subject+ the first form of verb (s/es)+ object (Active voice)
